en: A multi‑view vintage postcard showing several colored photographs of dramatic waterfalls, rapids, forested cliffs, a bridge over a river gorge, and a riverside hotel. Captions on each small image label specific viewpoints and features of the falls area. At the bottom, large stylized white letters spell out the destination name 'TROLLHÄTTAN'. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century tourist postcard highlighting the waterfalls and river scenery around Trollhättan.
